commands.title: Companion status
commands.description: Whether companion access is on, the port, the addresses it listens on, the hosts a pairing link carries, why it is not listening, this Mac's identity, the title-bar colour setting, the other Macs paired phones reported and whether the title bar shows this Mac's dot and whether a push relay is set: {enabled, port, listening, hosts, error, computer: {id, name, colour}, titleBarColour, otherMacs: [{name, colour, devices}], titleDot, push}.

commands.title: Allow companion devices
commands.description: Turn companion access on or off; returns the status.

commands.title: Set companion port
commands.confirm: Change the companion port? Paired devices stay offline until you pair them again.
commands.description: Change the TCP port companion access listens on (default 47621); restarts listening, drops open streams and the active pairing code. Paired devices keep the old port and must pair again. Ignored while CLUBMATE_REMOTE_LISTEN is set. Returns the status.

commands.title: Set Mac colour
commands.description: Set this Mac's identity colour shown next to its name on paired phones and in the title bar; publishes remote.identity. Returns the status.

commands.title: Show Mac colour in title bar
commands.description: Show or hide this Mac's colour dot in the title bar (shown only while a paired phone reports other Macs); returns the status.

commands.title: Pair device
commands.description: Turn companion access on and issue a one-time pairing code (5 minutes, replaces the previous one): {link, code, expiresAt}.

commands.title: Paired devices
commands.description: Paired devices, newest first: [{id, name, model, pairedAt, lastSeen, connected, macs: [{name, colour}]}]; macs are the other Macs that device has paired.

commands.title: Revoke device
commands.confirm: Revoke this device's access to Clubmate?
commands.description: Forget a paired device: its token stops working and its open streams close.

commands.title: Set push relay
commands.description: Set the push relay paired phones get push notifications through: the relay's https url and this Mac's relay token (cmr_…, from `clubmate-push-relay token add` on the relay host). An empty url clears both. Returns the status.

url.description: Relay base url, https://<host>[:port]; empty clears the relay.
